about: Known findings of `census lint` (accepted, only others fail) with what to trace for each (todo, empty: nothing to do), and more things to trace no check finds (tasks). `python -m funbots_debug.census lint --todo` lists them by level. tasks.todo: Optional (works at runtime since 2026-10-13): MCOM 7 stands in a ticket office (-219.9, 64.6, -531.5) behind two glass doors (south (-216.8, 65, -537.9), east (-210.4, 65, -529)) and a selling desk; the census measured it with the doors closed, the mesh doesn't reach in. The bots go to the mesh point at the east door, shoot the glass and walk round the desk (Bot:_ZoneAction, _ZoneArmDetour); armed and destroyed in the test. Leaving the office they are put out (zone_force). A helper foot path from the mesh at (-209.5, 65, -528.5) through the east door, along z -529.3 to (-216.7, 64.6, -529.6) and to the MCOM would make it smoother.
